title: lecanthus obtusus
intro: Lecanthus obtusus, commonly known as Lantana camara, is a tropical shrub native to the Americas and the Caribbean. It is known for its clusters of small, fragrant flowers in shades of pink, yellow, and purple, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Lantana camara include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
